profile.name: Satyaprakash Sethy
profile.role: Python Backend Engineer | Backend Security | System Architecture
profile.positioning: Engineering Secure, Scalable & Reliable Backend Systems.
profile.summary: I build secure backend applications, enterprise authentication systems, and scalable APIs using Python and modern backend technologies. I focus on system architecture, application security, performance, and delivering reliable production-ready solutions.
profile.about: I am a Python Backend Engineer with strong experience in backend architecture, enterprise authentication, API security, and scalable applications. I design and build Python-based backend systems with a focus on identity, API security, and dependable service delivery. My work spans centralized authentication, event platforms, secure workflows, and production APIs.
profile.headline: Engineering Secure, Scalable & Reliable Backend Systems.
profile.subheadline: I build secure backend applications, enterprise authentication systems, and scalable APIs using Python and modern backend technologies. I focus on system architecture, application security, performance, and delivering reliable production-ready solutions.

work.title: Centralized Single Sign-On Platform
work.summary: Backend development and technical ownership for a centralized identity platform used across more than 10 organizational products.
outcomes: Implemented backend workflows for user registration and role assignment.
Worked with Keycloak for authentication and session management.
Built and maintained APIs using Python and Django REST Framework.
Used MySQL, Redis caching, and Celery background tasks in the platform stack.

work.title: Event Management & Service Delivery Platform
work.summary: End-to-end backend work across event registration and digital learning services, including virtual labs, e-learning, quizzes, and certification.
outcomes: Developed backend APIs and workflows for event registration and service assignment.
Supported integrations and service delivery across event modules.
Contributed to a live event that remained available while serving approximately 8,000 concurrent users.
Worked across authentication, data handling, background tasks, and API security.

caseStudies.title: API Security & Business Logic Hardening
caseStudies.description: Identified and addressed API security issues, including request replay vulnerabilities, parameter tampering, secure file upload handling, and authentication, session management, and authorization controls.
caseStudies.impact: Strengthened API security, access control, and validation of critical backend business workflows

caseStudies.title: Centralized SSO & Identity Security
caseStudies.description: Worked on a centralized Single Sign-On platform using Keycloak, implementing authentication, session management, role-based access control, and secure access across 10+ organizational products.
caseStudies.impact: Enabled centralized identity management and secure authentication across multiple applications

caseStudies.title: Role-based consent management design
caseStudies.description: Worked through consent requirements for User, Coordinator, and PMU Manager workflows, including profile data, exam enrollment, coordinator uploads, and report review.
caseStudies.impact: Mapped consent capture to the data-collection workflows

caseStudies.title: Linux From Scratch build
caseStudies.description: Built a Linux distribution from source to learn toolchain bootstrapping, kernel configuration, and init system setup.
caseStudies.impact: Deepened OS internals and system-level debugging skills

caseStudies.title: Cybersecurity hands-on labs
caseStudies.description: Practical learning with Kali Linux, Nmap reconnaissance, Wireshark traffic analysis, and Burp Suite testing; Pre Security & Cyber Security 101 certificates.
caseStudies.impact: Applied offensive and defensive security fundamentals
